column7: GET /shares and /shares/owned ran their per-secret read decision with no request recorder, so every secret named only through a share wrote its own share_access_elevated row on every list call (one row per received share each time the page opened), burying real elevated reads/writes in list noise. The list now writes one share_access_elevated row per call (action shares.list, count, up to 50 secret/share pairs, truncated); a role reader writes none and a real elevated read of one secret still writes its own row (TestShareElevatedSecretRead_StillWritesItsOwnRow).
